customConcerns.aws_command: This command interacts with AWS infrastructure (aws cli, cdk, terraform against AWS, eksctl, etc.) and could affect live cloud resources or incur cost
customConcerns.touches_prod_kubernetes: This command targets a Kubernetes context or namespace that looks like production (prod, live, prd)
customConcerns.touches_billing_or_payments: This command touches billing, payment, or invoicing systems or data

escalation._comment: model: provider/id resolved through Pi's own model registry (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'), or '' to use whatever model your Pi session is already using. Auth comes from Pi's own model config - nothing extra to set up here. Escalates only when Jev's risk score AND confidence are both at or below the two thresholds; anything the LLM itself can't resolve to a clear allow/deny still falls through to asking you.
